title.en: Grid-aware mirror kinetic and ambipolar closure

summary: Select reference and plug planes on a rectilinear R-Z grid, interpolate their magnetic and potential profiles in flux, evaluate two end-loss states, run a nested local mirror quasineutral closure, and optionally mask selected returned density and pressure fields outside the plugs.

identity.relation: Rectilinear mirror grid and reference/plug planes to end-loss-coupled local quasineutral pressure state
identity.direction: (R-Z grid, B, psi, reference and plug planes, ion/electron state and controls) -> grid closure state, mapped end diagnostics and selected aliases
identity.definition: The first nearest z-axis indices to caller coordinates define left/reference/right rows, which must be ordered. The flux-profile operator interpolates B on all three rows from their psi samples to the full grid, and phi_ref from the reference row to the full grid. At each plug endpoint, the mirror ambipolar operator either evaluates a prescribed plug potential (default mode) or solves equal one-way ion/electron end currents (ambipolar_end_loss). Its reference-row endpoint potential is interpolated over full-grid psi. The nested mirror quasineutral graph solves local potential and pressure with those B/phi profiles. The parent adds endpoint diagnostics and legacy pressure/density/temperature aliases. Optional confinement zeroes only named top-level density, pressure and relative-charge-residual fields outside the nearest plug rows. Endpoint current_balance_solved flags distinguish prescribed evaluation from the requested bounded end-current solve; an unsolved endpoint is rejected in ambipolar_end_loss mode. Local converged refers to the separately terminal-verified quasineutral state.
identity.model: One positive-ion two-temperature mirror-moment closure with prescribed-temperature Boltzmann electrons and separate source-defined end-loss flux balance. Endpoint flux balance and local quasineutrality are different calculations; neither constitutes a self-consistent R-Z magnetic equilibrium.
identity.geometry: Caller-supplied rectilinear nonnegative-R, increasing-Z [N_Z,N_R] tensor grid with N_Z,N_R >= 2, positive B and three ordered nearest plane indices. Flux-surface interpolation assumes each selected row is representable as a single-valued scalar function of psi; the profile operator sorts and deduplicates samples with constant endpoint extension.
identity.coordinates: R and Z are in m; arrays are [Z,R]. psi is a caller-owned flux-profile coordinate: the historical source label is Wb, while a nested SciRel Hall field supplies psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad. Every sampled row and caller profile must use the same convention; this graph does not convert between them. Requested plane coordinates map to the first nearest z-axis index and need not equal grid nodes.
identity.boundary: Nearest selected left/reference/right indices must satisfy left < reference < right. Prescribed mode uses caller plug potentials or zero defaults; ambipolar_end_loss solves each endpoint independently and requires positive ion_loss_refill. Default confinement zeroes selected top-level fields outside the inclusive plug interval but leaves potentials, endpoint diagnostics, nested kinetic_moments, original moment-named fields and pitch integrals unmasked.
assumptions: All selected flux rows and the full grid use one compatible flux convention; if psi is rescaled, every psi-dependent caller profile must be defined in the rescaled coordinate. Interpolation does not establish physical flux-surface equivalence or uniqueness.

Reference density and temperature profiles need to be meaningful on both one-dimensional reference psi and two-dimensional grid psi; scalar values or shape-aware callables satisfy that interface, while an arbitrary full-grid array may fail at the endpoint operator.
The supplied species, electron and plug model is physically appropriate; a small numerical charge residual alone does not certify the source model or magnetic equilibrium.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.description: Cylindrical radial mesh coordinate R.
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonnegative first-row R axis strictly increasing; each row matches that axis within np.allclose.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.description: Axial mesh coordinate Z.
inputs.constraints: Finite first-column Z axis strictly increasing; each column matches that axis within np.allclose.

inputs.name: b_t
inputs.description: Current local magnetic-field magnitude.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.description: Caller-owned flux-profile coordinate on the grid.
inputs.constraints: Finite; sampled rows need at least two distinct psi coordinates for the bound profile operator. The historical source label is Wb; nested Hall supplies Wb/rad, so all psi-dependent profiles must follow the supplied coordinate.

inputs.name: mass_kg
inputs.description: Positive-ion particle mass.
inputs.constraints: Nested ion and endpoint operators require finite strictly positive value.

inputs.name: charge_c
inputs.description: Positive ion charge.
inputs.constraints: Nested quasineutral and endpoint operators require finite strictly positive charge.

inputs.name: density_ref_m3
inputs.description: Ion reference number density, reused at reference row and full grid.
inputs.shape: scalar or callable(psi) yielding reference-row and full-grid shapes
inputs.dtype: real numeric or callable yielding float64-convertible arrays
inputs.constraints: Finite nonnegative wherever evaluated; an [N_Z,N_R] fixed array generally cannot broadcast to the [N_R] endpoint psi and is not a universally supported form.

inputs.name: temperature_parallel_j
inputs.description: Ion parallel reference thermal energy.
inputs.shape: scalar or callable(psi) yielding reference-row and full-grid shapes
inputs.dtype: real numeric or callable yielding float64-convertible arrays
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive wherever evaluated; fixed 2-D arrays may fail endpoint broadcasting.

inputs.name: temperature_perpendicular_ref_j
inputs.description: Ion perpendicular reference thermal energy.
inputs.shape: scalar or callable(psi) yielding reference-row and full-grid shapes
inputs.dtype: real numeric or callable yielding float64-convertible arrays
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive wherever evaluated; fixed 2-D arrays may fail endpoint broadcasting.

inputs.name: electron_temperature_j
inputs.description: Prescribed Boltzmann electron thermal energy, also used in endpoint fluxes.
inputs.shape: scalar or callable(psi) yielding reference-row and full-grid shapes
inputs.dtype: real numeric or callable yielding float64-convertible arrays
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive wherever evaluated; fixed 2-D arrays may fail endpoint broadcasting.

inputs.name: reference_z
inputs.description: Requested reference plane coordinate, mapped to nearest Z index.
inputs.constraints: Finite and mapped strictly between mapped plug indices.

inputs.name: plug_left_z
inputs.description: Requested left plug plane coordinate.
inputs.constraints: Finite; nearest index strictly below reference index.

inputs.name: plug_right_z
inputs.description: Requested right plug plane coordinate.
inputs.constraints: Finite; nearest index strictly above reference index.

inputs.name: electron_density_ref_m3
inputs.description: Optional electron reference density for both endpoint and nested closures.
inputs.shape: scalar or callable(psi) yielding reference-row and full-grid shapes
inputs.dtype: null, real numeric or callable yielding float64-convertible arrays
inputs.constraints: Omission derives charge-state times ion density; if provided, finite nonnegative and same active mask as ion reference density for the nested solve.

inputs.name: phi_ref_v
inputs.description: Reference potential sampled on the reference psi row, then interpolated over the full grid.
inputs.dtype: real numeric or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Finite and broadcastable to the one-dimensional reference row; a fixed [N_Z,N_R] array is not accepted.

inputs.name: phi_plug_left_v
inputs.description: Prescribed left endpoint potential in prescribed mode.
inputs.dtype: real numeric or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Finite and reference-row broadcastable if prescribed mode; ignored in ambipolar_end_loss mode.

inputs.name: phi_plug_right_v
inputs.description: Prescribed right endpoint potential in prescribed mode.
inputs.dtype: real numeric or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Finite and reference-row broadcastable if prescribed mode; ignored in ambipolar_end_loss mode.

inputs.name: plug_potential_mode
inputs.description: Endpoint potential evaluation or end-current-balance solve.
inputs.constraints: Only 'prescribed' or 'ambipolar_end_loss'.

inputs.name: loss_cone_refill
inputs.description: Refill fraction passed to the nested mirror moments and used as default ion_loss_refill.
inputs.constraints: Nested moments require finite [0,1]; ambipolar_end_loss requires a positive ion_loss_refill, supplied separately or inherited here.

inputs.name: quadrature_order
inputs.description: Finite pitch quadrature order for nested mirror moments.
inputs.dtype: Python or NumPy integer, excluding bool
inputs.constraints: At least 8; unlike the nested moment leaf, this parent rejects nonintegral values before dispatch.

inputs.name: ion_loss_refill
inputs.description: Ion one-way endpoint-flux refill, overriding the loss_cone_refill default.
inputs.constraints: Finite [0,1]; strictly positive for ambipolar_end_loss mode. The endpoint operator itself defaults to 1.0, but this graph always passes the parent-derived value.

inputs.name: electron_loss_refill
inputs.description: Electron one-way endpoint-flux refill.
inputs.constraints: Finite in (0,1].

inputs.name: potential_tolerance_v
inputs.description: Absolute endpoint-potential tolerance for end-current solve.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; independent of the nested quasineutral graph's default tolerance.

inputs.name: current_tolerance
inputs.description: Endpoint log-current-ratio convergence tolerance.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive.

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.description: Endpoint ambipolar bisection limit.
inputs.dtype: Python or NumPy integer, excluding bool
inputs.constraints: At least one; this parent passes it only to endpoint solves and does not override the nested graph's separate default 100.

inputs.name: initial_bracket_thermal
inputs.description: Initial endpoint-potential bracket half-width in thermal-voltage units.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; passed only to endpoint solves.

inputs.name: confine_to_plug_planes
inputs.description: Whether selected top-level returned fields are zeroed outside nearest plug rows.
inputs.constraints: A boolean scalar only, not numeric 0/1. It does not mask all returned fields.

outputs.name: p_parallel
outputs.description: Total ion-plus-electron parallel pressure, masked outside plugs by default.
outputs.constraints: Top-level mask does not alter active rows.

outputs.name: p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Total ion-plus-electron perpendicular pressure, masked outside plugs by default.
outputs.constraints: Top-level mask does not alter active rows.

outputs.name: ion_density
outputs.description: Ion density from nested closure, masked outside plugs by default.
outputs.constraints: May differ from unmasked density_m3 outside plugs.

outputs.name: electron_density
outputs.description: Boltzmann electron density, masked outside plugs by default.
outputs.constraints: The top-level field is zero outside the inclusive plug interval when confinement is enabled.

outputs.name: electrostatic_potential
outputs.description: Nested local quasineutral potential.
outputs.constraints: Never masked by confine_to_plug_planes.

outputs.name: relative_charge_residual
outputs.description: Nested relative ion-charge/electron-density residual, masked outside plugs by default.
outputs.constraints: Not the endpoint log-current ratio.

outputs.name: kinetic_moments
outputs.description: Full nested mirror ion-moment mapping.
outputs.constraints: Remains full-grid even when selected top-level aliases are masked.

outputs.name: ion_p_parallel
outputs.description: Ion parallel pressure component, masked outside plugs by default.
outputs.constraints: Original p_parallel_pa remains unmasked.

outputs.name: ion_p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Ion perpendicular pressure component, masked outside plugs by default.
outputs.constraints: Original p_perpendicular_pa remains unmasked.

outputs.name: electron_pressure
outputs.description: Electron pressure component, masked outside plugs by default.
outputs.constraints: No separate masked copy in kinetic_moments.

outputs.name: density_m3
outputs.description: Original nested ion density under moment-field name.
outputs.constraints: Unmasked even when ion_density and density are zeroed outside plugs.

outputs.name: p_parallel_pa
outputs.description: Original nested ion parallel pressure.
outputs.constraints: Unmasked even when ion_p_parallel is zeroed outside plugs.

outputs.name: p_perpendicular_pa
outputs.description: Original nested ion perpendicular pressure.
outputs.constraints: Unmasked even when ion_p_perpendicular is zeroed outside plugs.

outputs.name: temperature_parallel_j
outputs.description: Original nested ion parallel thermal-energy parameter.
outputs.constraints: Unmasked; not pressure over depleted density.

outputs.name: temperature_perpendicular_local_j
outputs.description: Original nested local perpendicular thermal-energy parameter.
outputs.constraints: Unmasked.

outputs.name: untruncated_density_m3
outputs.description: Original nested ion density before loss-cone pitch depletion.
outputs.constraints: Unmasked even when untruncated_density alias is masked.

outputs.name: density_pitch_integral
outputs.description: Density pitch-occupation integral factor.
outputs.constraints: Full-grid diagnostic; never masked.

outputs.name: parallel_pitch_integral
outputs.description: Parallel-pressure pitch-occupation integral factor.
outputs.constraints: Full-grid diagnostic; never masked.

outputs.name: perpendicular_pitch_integral
outputs.description: Perpendicular-pressure pitch-occupation integral factor.
outputs.constraints: Full-grid diagnostic; never masked.

outputs.name: iterations
outputs.description: Nested local quasineutral bisection iteration count.
outputs.constraints: Not the two endpoint iteration counts, which are not exposed by this graph.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: Nested local quasineutral convergence flag.
outputs.constraints: Endpoint states must also have returned successfully, but their flags are not exposed.

outputs.name: end_left_potential_v
outputs.description: Left endpoint potential interpolated from reference-row psi to the full grid.
outputs.constraints: Full-grid, unmasked.

outputs.name: end_left_ion_particle_flux_m2_s
outputs.description: Mapped left one-way ion particle flux.
outputs.constraints: Interpolated in psi, not spatially propagated.

outputs.name: end_left_electron_particle_flux_m2_s
outputs.description: Mapped left one-way electron particle flux.
outputs.constraints: Interpolated in psi, not spatially propagated.

outputs.name: end_left_log_current_ratio
outputs.description: Mapped left logarithmic ion/electron current ratio.
outputs.constraints: Endpoint diagnostic, not nested charge residual.

outputs.name: end_left_relative_current_residual
outputs.description: Mapped left relative ion/electron current residual.
outputs.constraints: Endpoint diagnostic, not nested charge residual.

outputs.name: end_right_potential_v
outputs.description: Right endpoint potential interpolated from reference-row psi to the full grid.
outputs.constraints: Full-grid, unmasked.

outputs.name: end_right_ion_particle_flux_m2_s
outputs.description: Mapped right one-way ion particle flux.
outputs.constraints: Interpolated in psi, not spatially propagated.

outputs.name: end_right_electron_particle_flux_m2_s
outputs.description: Mapped right one-way electron particle flux.
outputs.constraints: Interpolated in psi, not spatially propagated.

outputs.name: end_right_log_current_ratio
outputs.description: Mapped right logarithmic ion/electron current ratio.
outputs.constraints: Endpoint diagnostic, not nested charge residual.

outputs.name: end_right_relative_current_residual
outputs.description: Mapped right relative ion/electron current residual.
outputs.constraints: Endpoint diagnostic, not nested charge residual.

outputs.name: density
outputs.description: Ion density alias for downstream Hall closure.
outputs.constraints: Alias of ion_density before optional masking; selected top-level field is masked by default.

outputs.name: T_parallel_J
outputs.description: Ion parallel thermal-energy alias from kinetic_moments.
outputs.constraints: Unmasked; not recalculated from masked pressure/density.

outputs.name: T_perpendicular_local_J
outputs.description: Local ion perpendicular thermal-energy alias from kinetic_moments.
outputs.constraints: Unmasked; not recalculated from masked pressure/density.

outputs.name: untruncated_density
outputs.description: Ion untruncated-density alias, masked outside plugs by default.
outputs.constraints: Original untruncated_density_m3 remains unmasked.

outputs.name: end_left_current_balance_solved
outputs.description: Whether this endpoint was solved for current balance, separately from local quasineutral convergence.
outputs.constraints: False in prescribed mode; True in ambipolar_end_loss mode.

outputs.name: end_right_current_balance_solved
outputs.description: Whether this endpoint was solved for current balance, separately from local quasineutral convergence.
outputs.constraints: False in prescribed mode; True in ambipolar_end_loss mode.

preconditions: A finite rectilinear R-Z grid with positive B and three distinct ordered nearest plane indices is supplied.
The three sampled psi rows contain enough distinct values for flux-profile interpolation, and caller reference profiles are evaluable on both reference-row and full-grid psi.
The positive-ion and Boltzmann-electron states meet the bound endpoint and nested-closure contracts.
supported: Prescribed or separately solved two-end potentials mapped through a flux coordinate to a local grid quasineutral closure.
Optional zeroing of selected top-level density, pressure and charge-residual fields outside the nearest plug rows.
excluded: A general R-Z equilibrium solve, magnetic-field construction, spatially resolved kinetic transport, or multi-ion/electron-anisotropy closure.

Automatic reconciliation of Wb and Wb/rad flux conventions, arbitrary full-grid fixed reference profiles at the one-dimensional endpoint call, or a comprehensive masking guarantee for every returned field.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for nonmapping or missing required inputs, unequal/non-2-D/nonfinite grids, nonrectilinear or too-small axes, nonpositive B, nonfinite or unordered nearest plane indices, invalid mode, nonboolean confinement control, or quadrature_order that is not an integer >=8. Bound operators also reject invalid profile sample geometry, species, temperature, density, refill or potential controls; fixed 2-D profile arrays can fail at the one-dimensional endpoint call.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Any profile, endpoint or nested graph exception propagates. Requested end-current solves must explicitly report converged and current_balance_solved; otherwise RuntimeError. Nested local terminal residual and finite species assembly gates must pass before return.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: In ambipolar_end_loss mode each endpoint potential uses its bound finite iteration limit, default 100; the nested local potential solve separately uses its own default 100. Either failure aborts the whole graph. Prescribed endpoint mode evaluates fluxes at supplied potentials without solving endpoint current balance.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No mapping is returned on any upstream failure. A successful mapping includes full-grid nested and endpoint diagnostics even when selected top-level fields are confined.

example.description: Evaluate two end potentials and a quasineutral pressure state on a small rectilinear mirror grid.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import solve_grid_mirror_kinetic_closure
e = 1.602176634e-19
r, z = np.linspace(0.0, 0.2, 5), np.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, 7)
R, Z = np.meshgrid(r, z)
state = solve_grid_mirror_kinetic_closure({'r_grid': R, 'z_grid': Z, 'b_t': 1.0 + 3.0*np.abs(Z), 'psi': 0.5*R**2, 'mass_kg': 1.67262192595e-27, 'charge_c': e, 'density_ref_m3': 1.0e18, 'temperature_parallel_j': 1000.0*e, 'temperature_perpendicular_ref_j': 2000.0*e, 'electron_temperature_j': 500.0*e, 'reference_z': 0.0, 'plug_left_z': -1.0, 'plug_right_z': 1.0, 'loss_cone_refill': 0.05, 'quadrature_order': 24, 'plug_potential_mode': 'ambipolar_end_loss'})
assert state['p_parallel'].shape == R.shape
assert np.all(state['end_left_potential_v'] < 0.0)
assert np.max(np.abs(state['relative_charge_residual'])) < 1e-9
assert state['end_left_current_balance_solved'] and state['end_right_current_balance_solved']
example.expected: A [7,5] pressure field, negative mapped left end potential and small relative local charge residual for the selected test state.

scope: Grid-aware endpoint mapping and nested local charge closure for one positive-ion mirror case, with relative charge residual below 1e-9.

Fixed-profile pressure, density and endpoint-potential results are unchanged when the supplied psi interpolation coordinate is rescaled by 2*pi; a separate unadjusted psi-dependent density callback changes the returned density under the same rescaling.
Prescribed endpoint potentials return unbalanced end-current diagnostics while the nested local quasineutral solve converges on the selected case.
Nearest-plane confinement of selected top-level rows while original moment fields, endpoint diagnostics and three full-grid pitch factors remain unmasked.

Endpoint and nested graph failures propagate without a terminal state; callable reference-density evaluation and rejection of a 2-D reference-potential field, nonrectilinear/nonfinite grids, numeric confinement flag and quadrature order below eight or nonintegral.
Injected endpoint evaluation masquerading as a solved balance is rejected before the nested local closure.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel graph tests support the selected [7,5] grid cases, prescribed-endpoint imbalance, endpoint and nested residual assertions, fixed-profile psi-coordinate rescaling and one unadjusted-callback counterexample, chosen masking behavior, upstream failure propagation and input rejects. They do not establish all profile domains, end-current balance over all states, physical correctness of the mirror model, full-grid array-profile support, automatic conversion or arbitrary psi-dependent callback equivalence, current expert approval or public release.
known_limitations: Input YAML describes fixed full-grid reference profiles more broadly than the actual endpoint-plus-nested call chain supports; the shared profile must work on both one-dimensional and two-dimensional psi.
Confinement masks only selected top-level fields; the nested kinetic mapping, original moment-named values, temperatures, potentials, pitch integrals and endpoint diagnostics stay full-grid.
Nearest-plane selection can differ from the requested physical coordinate and the flux-profile operator uses source-defined sorting, deduplication and constant endpoint extension.
Independent endpoint and nested nonlinear solves expose no combined convergence certificate; source licensing and current-version expert recognition remain pending.

nodes.description: Validate the rectangular grid and controls, select first-nearest ordered plane indices, extract psi/B rows, shape caller reference potential, and carry declared species/control values without introducing a physical closure.
Interpolate reference and plug B rows and reference potential against caller psi before endpoint evaluation; repeated invocations of one bound operator.
Run the end-loss operator once per side in evaluate mode for prescribed plug potentials or solve mode for ambipolar_end_loss.
Map both endpoint potentials and flux/current diagnostics from reference-row psi onto full-grid psi.
Solve the nested local quasineutral potential, ion/electron state and total pressure on the full grid.
Add mapped end diagnostics and legacy aliases, and optionally zero only the declared top-level fields outside the inclusive plug interval.

execution.ordering: Validate grid and select first-nearest ordered plane rows; interpolate B and phi_ref in psi; evaluate/solve left and right endpoint states; interpolate endpoint potential and diagnostics to the grid; run nested local quasineutral closure; append aliases and optionally confine selected top-level fields. Scientific dependencies are acyclic; endpoint and nested bisection are owned by their bound assets.
branches: prescribed calls endpoint mode=evaluate at caller potentials or zero defaults; ambipolar_end_loss calls endpoint mode=solve and requires positive ion_loss_refill.
Absent electron_density_ref_m3 lets each bound closure derive the charge-state-scaled electron reference density.
confine_to_plug_planes defaults true and masks only the named top-level fields; false preserves all full-grid scientific fields.
execution.state_ownership: The caller owns input arrays and profile callables. The graph holds local array views/conversions, nearest indices, interpolated profiles, endpoint mappings and a returned nested state; it adds and selectively replaces top-level arrays but does not mutate caller inputs or persist state between calls.
execution.failure_propagation: Any grid, profile, endpoint or nested closure failure propagates without fallback or partial result. The parent does not turn endpoint or nested nonconvergence into a successful pressure state.
